# pve_ceph_install (Action)

Install the Ceph packages on a node (`pveceph install`). **Requires the provider's `ssh` block**: the Proxmox VE API has no install endpoint, so this action runs `/usr/sbin/pveceph install` on the node over SSH (as `root`, or through `sudo -n` — see the provider guide for the exact sudoers rule). It is idempotent: if Ceph is already installed it does nothing unless `force` is set. Run it before `pve_ceph_init`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the provider's ssh block: the Proxmox VE API cannot install packages.
action "pve_ceph_install" "pve1" {
  config {
    node       = "pve1"
    repository = "no-subscription"
  }
}

# Idempotent: nothing runs if Ceph is already installed on the node.
resource "terraform_data" "ceph_packages" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ceph_install.pve1]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Node to install Ceph on.

### Optional

- `allow_experimental` (Boolean) Allow experimental Ceph versions (`--allow-experimental`).
- `force` (Boolean) Run `pveceph install` even if Ceph already responds on the node (for example to upgrade packages).
- `repository` (String) Ceph APT repository: `enterprise` (needs a subscription), `no-subscription`, or `test`. Defaults to `no-subscription`.
- `version` (String) Ceph release code name to install (for example `squid`). Defaults to the release `pveceph` recommends.
